decisions.reason: Reusing content and colors on Ridgehaven and the new main site does not change whether the legacy Harbor Valley site remains available or how the master site links to it.
The source identifies content-reuse targets but establishes no new SEO-preservation or migration-handling rule.

The source reaffirms use of Shatter House colors and logos on the Ridgehaven and main sites, which is already covered by the existing cross-location brand consistency, approved logo, and MASTER_SITE/LOCATION_SITES scope.
Content and visual reuse across sites does not change location-specific booking placement, isolation, or activation.
The source does not change separate analytics, reporting, revenue, or sales tracking for each location.
Applying reused content to the Ridgehaven and main sites does not change the selectable locations, selector placement, or location-routing behavior.
The phrase 'with the style they have' does not unambiguously establish a new design reference or resolve the candidate's existing uncertainty, so no safe MODIFY can be propagated.
The source changes content-reuse targets but does not alter separate Wix accounts, payment setups, or payout isolation.
Shared content and visual presentation do not change the requirement for Ridgehaven's customer database to remain separate.
The content-reuse decision has no necessary effect on location-specific gift-card operations.
The source does not change the operational separation of Ridgehaven memberships from Harbor Valley.
Referring to the 'new main site' as a content-reuse target does not change its configured domain or domain-to-website mapping.
